definition: Generalized regression neural network (GRNN) is a variation to radial basis neural networks.
details: GRNN was suggested by D.F. Specht in 1991. GRNN can be used for regression, prediction, and classification. GRNN can also be a good solution for online dynamical systems. GRNN represents an improved technique in the neural networks based on the nonparametric regression. The idea is that every training sample will represent a mean to a radial basis neuron.
story: Imagine a factory floor where each workstation can glance at every other workstation before doing its part. It is the blueprint that makes everything else possible. At the bottom of every machine is a design — the shape of it, and how its pieces talk to each other. Structure decides what the model can even express — the blueprint before the bricks. That blueprint is General regression neural network.
